recreation_brief:
1. Create a 16:9 slide with a pure white (#FFFFFF) background; leave roughly the lower two-thirds and the entire left half completely empty.
2. Draw a thin red (#E23B3F) rectangle outline inset about 6% from the left, 8% from the top and 4% from the bottom, extending to about 94% of the slide width; render the right edge as a faint gray hairline.
3. Insert the neural-network diagram image (or redraw it) as a wide landscape panel at x ~36%-79%, y ~11%-41% of the slide, with a light beige (#E8DCD0) fill. Inside it: three magenta (#CC00CC) dots at far left fanning via thin gray lines to three white circles with red (#C00000) 'Σ'; from each Σ an arrow labeled italic red 'f' to a small circle labeled 'o' plus two small empty circles; a second column of three white/red 'Σ' circles; a column of three green (#00A651) circles with green 'Σ'; three green squares labeled 'f' then three green squares labeled 'o'; and three white boxes with thin black outlines labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'.
4. Add red italic 'w_ij' labels on the forward arrows between the middle Σ columns, blue (#0070C0) italic 'w_ji' labels on blue backward arrows, and red italic 'w_jk' labels on the arrows leading to the green 'f' squares; overlay several magenta diagonal error-path lines across the network center.
5. Add three yellow (#FFFF00) circles along the top of the diagram labeled 'w_ij', 'w_jk', 'w_ki' in red, joined by black curved arrows arching rightward.
6. Add along the bottom of the diagram: a blue upward arrow under the middle Σ column, a solid purple (#CC00CC) circle with a white 'L', and a green double-headed vertical arrow under the green Σ column; place a small purple 'N' circle logo and the purple text 'Nikhil Sree' at the panel's bottom-left.
7. Immediately right of the diagram, add a narrow crimson (#B01C2E) vertical bar (about 12 x 110 px) with white bold text 'Error Error Error' rotated 90° counter-clockwise.
8. To the right of that bar, stack three small bold green labels: 'Class 1' (top), 'Class 2' (middle), 'Class ∞ [?]' (bottom).
9. Further right, place the equation '∂E/∂w_ij' as a stacked fraction (∂E over ∂w_ij, 'ij' subscript) in black serif math type at roughly 20 pt, and add a large bold red (#FF0000) '?' immediately to its right.
10. In the extreme top-right corner, add a yellow rounded rectangle with a magenta outline containing a large purple '8'.
11. Do not add any title, subtitle, or bullet text; do not fill the blank white areas.
